passage:
Wes is a hog. 
A hog is a big pig. 
The sun is up. 
Wes’ skin is hot.

He sits in the mud in his pen. 
Wes is wet. 
The mud drip, drip, drips from his skin.

“Ahh!,” said Wes. 
He is glad he gets to sit in the mud.
